note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published by PlayStation. Every guide below is written in my own words for this entry, built only from the official description, and cites its source by name.

trophies.guide: This is the platinum, and it unlocks on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing separate to do for it. Treat it as your finish line: follow the roadmap stages in order and it will pop last. Because it depends on everything else, plan the three missable trophies early so nothing blocks it.
trophies.missable_reason: earned by story progress — it unlocks once the other 54 trophies are earned
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in roadmap order
Watch the tracker — when it reads 54 of 54, the platinum unlocks

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing from the start of the story and see it through to its end. It is the first mission of the game, so it unlocks naturally as you play and cannot be missed. If you are starting fresh, this is the first trophy you will earn.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Complete the opening mission Gone Fishing

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Play through the chapter's missions in order until the chapter closes and the trophy pops. Story progress only — no side content is needed for it.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Play the Chapter 1 missions in story order

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. Keep playing the main missions in order after Chapter 1 until this chapter closes. Like every chapter trophy, it comes from story progress alone and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Play the Chapter 2 missions in story order

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. Play the chapter's missions in order until the chapter ends. It is a story milestone, so it unlocks as you play and is never missable.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Play the Chapter 3 missions in story order

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. Play through the chapter's missions in order until it closes. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and it comes from story progress alone.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Play the Chapter 4 missions in story order

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. This is the last story mission, so it unlocks when the main story ends — finish the chapters first and the finale follows naturally. It is a gold trophy because it marks the end of the whole story.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Play the mission when it appears in the story and finish it. Mission trophies unlock from story progress alone, so just keep playing the main missions in order.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Play it when it appears in the story and see it through to the end. It is a named mission trophy, so it comes from story progress and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Play it when it appears in the story and finish it. Named mission trophies unlock from story progress alone, so there is nothing extra to prepare.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play it when it appears in the story and finish it. Named mission trophies come from story progress alone, so keep playing the main missions in order.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Play it when it appears in the story and see it through. It is a named mission trophy, so it unlocks from story progress and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Play it when it appears in the story and finish it. Like the other named missions, it comes from story progress alone.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion across the game. Completion covers story, side content, activities and collectibles, so work through the roadmap stages and use the tracker to find what is left. This is the last big goal before the platinum, so save it for stage 4 when everything else is nearly done.
trophies.missable_reason: earned by story progress — completion builds up across all content
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Finish the story and the roadmap stages
Clear the remaining activities, collectibles and challenges until completion reads 100%

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are the game's driving tricks — jumps, drifts and near misses — so they build up naturally while you drive. Keep driving boldly between missions and the count climbs; check the in-game stats to see how close you are.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Drive fast, jump and drift around Leonida
Repeat stunt driving until the count reaches 250

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sample one of every activity the game offers — the trophy counts variety, not mastery. Work through the activities in this guide and tick each type off as you try it.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Find the 9 activity types across Leonida

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the Shooting Range and work through its 42 challenges, aiming for gold on each one. Practise a challenge until the gold standard is met, then move on to the next.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Find each drone race location and win the race there. Fourteen wins, one per location, completes it.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun Drone Race locations
Win a race at each location

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Race in 20 distinct race events and take first place in each. Different events count — repeating the same race does not add to the total, so keep entering new ones.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take on Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him. Fishing challenges are found through the game's fishing spots — bring patience and beat his score.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Out-fish Cal and win the challenge

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Find an arcade machine and play a game through to its end. Any arcade game counts — finishing one is enough.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Play an arcade game through to the end

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Work through Andy's mission strand until his last mission appears, then finish it. Character finales unlock by playing that character's missions in order.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's mission strand until his last mission appears, then finish it. Character finales unlock by playing that character's missions in order.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Work through Billy's mission strand until his last mission appears, then finish it. Character finales unlock by playing that character's missions in order.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Find strangers with missions to offer and finish 8 of their full strands. Explore the map for stranger markers and work through each strand to its end.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Find strangers offering missions across Leonida

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Work through Randy's mission strand until his last mission appears, then finish it. Character finales unlock by playing that character's missions in order.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Work through Tyrone's mission strand until his last mission appears, then finish it. Character finales unlock by playing that character's missions in order.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. Find all 18 meditation spots and meditate at each. Explore the state to uncover them, and tick them off in the tracker as you go.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Find the 18 meditation spots across Leonida

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take on Bret's hunt and track down the unique animal he wants. Hunting runs through Bret's strand — follow his missions until the hunt opens up.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Follow Bret's strand to the hunt
Hunt the unique animal for Bret

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Gather cards across Leonida until 3 full sets are complete. Cards are scattered through the world — collect steadily as you explore and the sets will fill in.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK It interaction at 100 different locations around Leonida. It is a long grind — hit new spots as you travel and the count climbs toward 100.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Use WAiNK It at new locations as you travel

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Work through the game's challenges — any 50 of them — and finish them. Challenges cover many kinds of play, so mix driving, combat and activities and the count builds on its own.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Take on challenges across driving, combat and activities

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops together. Pick a quiet escape route and break line of sight until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Reach a 4-star Wanted Level, then escape until the stars clear

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob three shops in a row with your partner along, keeping the same wanted level through all three. Plan a route with shops close together and keep moving between them.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Rob 3 shops in a row without losing your Wanted Level

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Find and drive 100 different vehicles across Leonida. New models count when you discover them — vary what you drive and explore car parks, streets and garages.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus and drop 5 enemies before it ends. Pick a fight with a crowd of enemies and line up your shots while focus is active.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Find a fight with several enemies
Activate Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies in one use

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave the airport in a way the schedule never planned — the description points at the airport itself. Head to VCIA and find a way out that is not a scheduled flight.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description points at the Rhino tank — get into a Rhino and make use of it. Tanks are heavy military hardware, so expect a fight to reach one.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan a quiet jewelry store robbery and get out unseen. Avoid cameras and guards, move slowly, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away clean each time. Vault robberies are big jobs — plan the escape before you go in.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Rob 5 vaults and escape each time

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck, rob it, and escape with the take. Trucks run routes through the city — intercept one and be ready to run.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Find an armored truck on its route

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Visit every one of the 52 areas on the map. Drive through each area until the map counts it explored — the tracker helps you see what is left.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Hit one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Learn which gang runs which operation and work through all nine.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Learn which gang runs each illegal operation
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. A quiet moment — no combat needed.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Order a cocktail and enjoy the view

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle out through a showroom in the most dramatic way possible. Pick a showroom, get a car inside, and smash your way out.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom with a car

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Visit the bowling alley and play through a game. Bowling is one of the game's social activities — follow through on your turn.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Play through a game of bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one is about a partnership moment — play through partner content until the moment lands. Follow partner missions and shared activities and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Play partner missions and shared activities

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. The game tracks your choices — the count runs to 500 — and some choices close off other paths, so this one can be locked by picking the wrong option. Make choices as the story offers them, and be aware that a choice can shut a door behind you. If a path is locked, a new playthrough may be needed to see the other side.
trophies.missable_reason: Choices can lock other paths — a wrong choice may close this off
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Make choices as the story offers them
Keep choices in mind — some close off other paths

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This trophy is about failing first and succeeding second — succeeding on the first try may skip it. If you clear the attempt first time, the second-chance moment never happens. Deliberately let the first attempt fail, then succeed on the retry.
trophies.missable_reason: Needs a failed first attempt — succeeding first try may skip it
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Fail the attempt on purpose the first time

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange happens once in Leonida — a one-off event that may not repeat. Keep an eye out for strange events while exploring, and be ready when one appears. Because it is a single strange moment, it can be missed if you are not there for it.
trophies.missable_reason: A one-off strange event that may not repeat
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Explore Leonida and watch for strange events
Be there when the strange moment happens

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive past a target and land the melee hit as you pass.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Get a vehicle moving past a target
Land a melee hit from the moving vehicle

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through your contacts until $250,000 is cleaned. Keep laundering as bills come in — the total builds over time.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Launder them through contacts until $250,000 is cleaned

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops. Buy gear, clothes and supplies as you play and the total climbs.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy every one of the 8 garage properties in Leonida. Save up and purchase them as they become available.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, then register each one through the app until you reach ten.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
steps: Register 10 of them in the Scooter Bros app
